ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Conversational Skills.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational Skills.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational Skills.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Conversational Skills.

2. When practising Selective Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Selective Listening.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Selective Listening.

   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Only memorise without using the language

7. When practising Phonological Awareness: Articulation, which approach is best? (1 mark)

----
